svg.title: R1: two nail cells and four compliant-pad cells
svg.desc: CH0 and CH1 occupy the two object-facing nail prongs. CH2 through CH5 follow the four TPU contact regions on their conformal saddles.

g.text: CH0 / CH1 on the hard nail · CH2–CH5 on conformal saddles along the soft contact surface
Start with N0 on both prongs.
All six cells use separate conductive-film islands, copper electrodes and insulating backing.
Released R1 geometry and active cut regions. This map is not a cutting template; fabricate from the R1 cut sheet.
